1606 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
184 days before July 15, 1606:  
Back up 184 days:  
July 15 → June 15 is 30 days (184–30=154 left)  
June 15 → May 15 is 31 days (154–31=123 left)  
May 15 → April 15 is 30 days (123–30=93 left)  
April 15 → March 15 is 31 days (93–31=62 left)  
March 15 → Feb 15 is 28 days (62–28=34 left)  
Feb 15 → Jan 15 is 31 days (34–31=3 left)  
Jan 15 – 3 days = Jan 12, 1606.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1606-01-12
